save-export.purpose: Actual native saves before world and after display composition; decode embedded thumbnails, check live image immutability, exact preceding displayed-frame selection and independent history.

save-settings.purpose: Actual post-composition save after SSAA/MSAA transitions. Resource changes intentionally invalidate history, unlike independent export.

demo-movie.purpose: Real demo playback/movie caller exports the preceding presented image before advancing playback. Every movie frame must exactly match its independently captured display.

screenshot-normal.purpose: Normal screenshot request through the game-owned final composition boundary; exact published-frame comparison.

screenshot-clean.purpose: Native clean screenshot request before publication, export at the completed-frame boundary.

requiredLog: capture native screenshot requested mode=3 frame=20
screenshot-double.purpose: Native doubled PNG: exact 2x nearest duplication of the same published frame, not a second simulation/render.

requiredLog: capture native screenshot requested mode=1 frame=20
screenshot-tga.purpose: Native bitmap readback/TGA export, compared with the same published frame at its documented 5-bit color precision.

decoded-movie.purpose: Actual windowed mission movie entry, decoded mutable bitmap into explicit display color at native video dimensions, exact source-pixel check and distinct consecutive frames, then restoration/resumed gameplay. This clip has no subtitles.

decoded-movie-paletted.purpose: Native paletted MV8 decode, palette translation and per-frame upload into the explicit display canvas, then restore gameplay.

quicksave.purpose: Actual QuickSaveGame against the copied input slot, independent thumbnail decode, preceding display preservation and temporal continuity.

save-dialog.purpose: Real save dialog over a presented world, including its deferred native thumbnail preview/cursor paint, then cancel and resume. Does not accept a slot or write a save.

modal-ui.purpose: Real options menu over a completed gameplay display; export the modal UI composition, then resume and export gameplay.

auxiliary-lifecycle.purpose: Real guidebot popup/deletion/same-slot replacement, static interval and base-view restoration, with duplicate-timer and GPU-mask assertions.
